The project

About

Slavery Atlas compares the slave systems of history, from Mesopotamia to the present day, civilisation by civilisation, with their orders of magnitude and their sources.

Why this site

Slavery existed on every continent and in almost every era. Public debate often focuses on the transatlantic slave trade: this site places it among the other systems, without downplaying its gravity or its specific features, so that a fact-based comparison is possible.

Method

Every page cites its scholarly sources. Volumes are given as ranges where historians disagree, and debated points are presented with the arguments of the different schools. Details are on the Method and sources page.

Status of the figures

The figures come from preliminary documentary research and are being checked against the works cited. Spotted an error, or have a source to suggest? Write to us via the Contact page.

Languages and updates

The site is published in seven languages; the French version is the reference. Last updated: 26 November 2026.
